name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help us improve Voice.AI
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Active AI Mode: [e.g. Cloud (Claude/OpenAI), Local (Ollama), Google Search only]
2. Spoken or typed query: [e.g. "system design why do CS engineer study", "what is 25 * 4"]
3. Observed Behavior: [e.g. text truncated in notch, no answer returned]
4. Expected Behavior: [e.g. answer fits notch cleanly, math evaluated]

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14.6 Sonoma, macOS 15.1 Sequoia, Windows 11]
- Hardware: [e.g. MacBook Pro M3 Pro, MacBook Air M2, PC x64]
- Voice.AI Version: [e.g. 1.0.0 (Build 42)]
- Active Language: [e.g. English, Hindi, Hinglish]

**Screenshots / Audio Clips**
If applicable, attach screenshots or short clips to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. permissions granted in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Accessibility / Microphone).
